answer: Each identity binds 12 months of recurring charity donations: 10 POA a month at the copper tier, each receipt carrying a unique pigment code filed on-chain, plus a 25 POA bond locked 90 days. A second record from one cluster doubles the bond (25, 50, 100, capped 800): 100 fakes lock 76,775 POA versus 2,500 POA honest, plus 120 POA each in donations. Each epoch a ripple audit re-confirms the last 3 receipts within 72 hours; two missed audits halve the bond and halt payouts for 3 epochs. Bought donation records double in price every 50 sold. Joint household donors pass one in-person check.
